name: Google reCAPTCHA
uiNote: Google reCAPTCHA (v2/v3) and related verification endpoints used to protect sites from spam, abuse, and automated traffic.
_note: Google reCAPTCHA provides human-verification challenges and behavioral analysis to protect websites from bots and abuse. It is often detected via global grecaptcha objects, g-recaptcha DOM classes, and scripts or verification endpoints under www.google.com/recaptcha and related /verify URLs. This definition is partially informed by vendor signals similar to those used in Scrapfly's open-source Antibot Detector.

name: Cloudflare security / Turnstile
uiNote: Cloudflare Turnstile and Bot Management challenges used for anti-bot checks, browser integrity tests, and CAPTCHA flows.
_note: Cloudflare's security stack includes Turnstile (CAPTCHA-like challenges) and Bot Management features that inspect browser behavior and block suspected automation. It is often detected via challenge options objects like _cf_chl_opt, bot-management cookies such as __cf_bm, and challenge scripts from challenges.cloudflare.com. This provider definition is partially informed by patterns similar to those surfaced by Scrapfly's Antibot Detector, which identifies Cloudflare bot management via window objects, challenge URLs, and bot-management cookies.

name: Castle
_note: Do NOT add abs.twimg.com as a domain; it hosts X front-end assets.

name: Castle (bundled)
uiNote: Detected from bundled first-party script. No provider-domain blocking is configured.

name: GeeTest
uiNote: GeeTest CAPTCHA challenges used for anti-bot verification and abuse protection.
_note: GeeTest provides interactive CAPTCHA challenges and anti-bot verification. This provider entry is partially informed by vendor signals similar to those surfaced by Scrapfly's Antibot Detector, which identifies GeeTest via content patterns and script URLs.

name: Google Tag Manager / gtag.js
uiNote: Detected via Google Tag Manager / gtag.js in the script chain. Observe-only by default; no provider-domain blocking is recommended.
_note: Use for attribution/logging when fingerprint calls occur with gtag.js in the chain. This is not a dedicated fingerprint vendor.

name: HTML-Load ad/fingerprinting canary
uiNote: Used by sites to load ads / canary scripts
_note: Used by sites to load ads / canary scripts via html-load.com / .cc when ad blockers are present

name: Comscore ScorecardResearch
uiNote: Audience and advertising measurement beacon from Comscore. Often loaded via third-party tags alongside ads and analytics.
_note: ScorecardResearch is a Comscore measurement tag used to collect page-view and visitor behavior data for audience and advertising analytics. Treat as a tracking/measurement vendor; not a dedicated fingerprint vendor, but may appear in the chain when fingerprint-like events occur.

name: Fastclick / Epsilon
_note: The hostname belongs to the fastclick.net domain, associated with Epsilon and typically fronted by Akamai.

name: DoubleVerify
uiNote: Ad verification and measurement tags from DoubleVerify. Commonly used to track ad impressions, viewability, and fraud across video and display inventory.
_note: DoubleVerify provides ad verification, fraud detection, and campaign measurement services. Domains such as vtrk.dv.tech and vast.doubleverify.com are used as tracking/measurement endpoints (for impression tags and VAST creatives) and will often fire alongside ad calls and other ad-tech vendors. Treat as an ad-tech measurement provider rather than a dedicated fingerprint vendor, but it may appear in chains that include fingerprint-like or profiling activity.

name: Cxense
uiNote: Content personalization and analytics tags from Cxense. Used to track page interactions and build profiles for recommendations and audience targeting.
_note: Cxense is a personalization and analytics platform that tracks user interactions, browser information, and other signals to build behavioral profiles and deliver targeted content or ads. Hostnames like cdn.cxense.com and scdn.cxense.com are commonly loaded as part of site analytics/personalization stacks. Treat as a tracking/personalization vendor; not a pure fingerprint provider, but it may co-occur with vendors that perform fingerprinting or more advanced profiling.

name: AWS WAF Bot Control
uiNote: Amazon Web Services Web Application Firewall (WAF) with bot control features, including browser challenges and integrity checks.
_note: AWS WAF Bot Control uses browser-based challenges and fingerprint-style checks (such as canvas/WebGL, script and header inspection) to distinguish bots from human traffic. URLs like token.awswaf.com and WAF-related /verify endpoints can indicate WAF challenges in progress. This provider definition is partially informed by Scrapfly's Antibot Detector, which flags AWS WAF via characteristic verification URLs and challenge resources.

name: CHEQ
uiNote: CHEQ bot management and security scripts used to detect automated traffic and protect sites from fraud.
_note: CHEQ provides bot detection and fraud prevention using browser fingerprinting and behavioral analysis. This provider entry is informed in part by Scrapfly's Antibot Detector, which identifies CHEQ as an anti-bot vendor via script content and network signatures.

name: Bombora Visitor Insights
uiNote: Bombora Visitor Insights tags identify and enrich website visitors in real time using cookies, IP, user-agent and engagement metrics to build marketing and intent profiles.
_note: Bombora's Visitor Insights JavaScript tag is deployed across brand sites and ads. Docs show preconnect/dns-prefetch hints to https://vi.ml314.com and a real-time tag that returns segment IDs for account-based marketing and personalization, indicating cross-site tracking and profiling behavior informed by Bombora’s own implementation guides and third-party tracker listings.

name: Meta Pixel
uiNote: Meta Pixel tracks website activity and sends events to Meta for ad targeting, audience building, conversion measurement, and profiling.
_note: Meta documents that the pixel tracks website activity via code commonly loaded from connect.facebook.net, especially fbevents.js. Related Meta-owned domains may appear in stacks or supporting script loads, but blocking should target the pixel delivery domain rather than blanket-blocking facebook.com.

name: LinkedIn Insight Tag
uiNote: LinkedIn Insight Tag tracks website conversions and visitor behavior for LinkedIn Ads, enabling retargeting and audience insights.
_note: LinkedIn documents the Insight Tag as a JavaScript-based tracking tag used to measure conversions, retarget visitors, and learn aggregate insights about LinkedIn members visiting a site. Requests are sent to px.ads.linkedin.com and related LinkedIn tracking endpoints.
